summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; joins str() of objects with sep and delegates once to print with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow "ignore", crop off, highlight defaulting to True). Added CHANGELOG entry "Added Console.out" under Unreleased/Added, a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after the logging section, and test_out_* tests in tests/test_console.py after test_print_style. Tests were not run, per instructions. Unverified: the highlight-override behavior (highlight=True on a console with highlighting disabled) is not covered by a plain-text assertion, and the render-hook test only checks that "FOO" appears in the output.
